name: Jarl Sigurd

intro.text: Behold, the Jarl of Lerwick! Well, this year's, anyway. It's a once in a lifetime job, you only get one go. I've grown a beard, learned to carry a torch with dignity and not fall over. One more thing: win me a battle.

win: A fine fight. The torches will remember it. Probably in the form of a smell.
after: Being Guizer Jarl is a lifetime ambition. You wait years, and the choosing is a fraction of the process. The honour is the brightest moment of a man's life and a very big bill for the cloak.
